artworks.title: Lueur precaire, une tete a l'infini suspendue(Precarious glimmering, a head suspended
artworks.description: This image features a rectangular frame with radiating lines holding the profile of a serene face. The face is suspended in a dark space, resembling a lantern or window. It emits a soft glow, reminiscent of moonlight or a distant star. Below the face, there are textured, wave-like forms and shadowy shapes suggesting undulating landscape or rough terrain, contrasting with the illuminated portrait and surrounding darkness.

artworks.title: Sous l'aile d'ombre, l'etre noir appliquait une active morsure (Beneath the wing of shadow the black creature was biting energetically)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged being standing on a barren landscape under a swirling sky. The image features a solitary figure with large wings, depicted in a dark manner. The sky above is rendered in swirling patterns, suggesting movement or change. A spherical object is positioned on the horizon. The drawing combines elements of shadow and light, lending a dramatic tone to the composition.

artworks.title: Pélerin du monde sublunaire (Pilgrim of the sublunary world)
artworks.description: The image contains swirling lines and dark shapes, creating an abstract scene. At the top right, a circular pattern resembles a glowing celestial body. On the left side, faint outlines suggest a figure in robes seated on a shadowy form. The composition hints at a journey through a mysterious landscape.

artworks.title: Le Jour (Day)
artworks.description: This is an image of an interior view through a window. The image shows a view from inside a darkened room looking out through a window, where a tree trunk with branches and leaves is visible. The window is divided into a grid by wooden mullions, creating smaller panes through which the scene outside is observed. The surrounding darkness of the room contrasts with the lighter outdoor scene framed by the window. The simplicity and composition suggest a play of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Yeux Clos (Closed Eyes)
artworks.description: The image shows a person's head and shoulders with eyes closed and head slightly tilted forward. The face has delicate lines and subtle shading. The hair is long and smooth, falling past the shoulders. The person's clothing is not clearly visible, but there are bare shoulders or minimal clothing above the chest. The background is textured with light pencil strokes. There are no visible jewelry pieces or objects. The overall image has a soft, monochromatic appearance, emphasizing the serene facial expression.

artworks.title: Bust of a Man Wearing a High Cap, Three-Quarters Right (The Artist's Father?)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person shown in a seated or standing position, with a slight turn towards the viewer's left. The facial features include a beard and mustache, and the lines in the etching create texture and detail, suggesting a mature or elderly face. The person's head is adorned with a large, soft cap that folds and drapes around the head. Clothing appears to consist of a robe or coat with a textured collar that gives the impression of wool or fur. There are no visible accessories or objects being held by the person. The background is plain and without any noticeable elements.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt: Small
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.2 x 6.5 cm (3 5/8 x 2 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rider on a donkey with another figure leading the donkey. The drawing depicts an outdoor scene in which a figure is seated on a donkey, swathed in a cloak. The donkey is loaded with bundles. Another figure, wearing a hat and holding a stick, leads the donkey. The background is filled with trees and greenery. The overall composition is detailed and evokes a sense of movement through a quietly atmospheric landscape. This is in the style of Rembrandt, known for his detailed etchings and masterful use of light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt: Altered from Seghers
artworks.medium: etching, burin and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is low, leaving ample space for the sky. In the distance, a strip of land and limited detail can be discerned. Detailed trees with dense foliage are prominent in the foreground. A figure on horseback is visible among the trees to the right, casting shadows. The artwork features intricate detailing, likely achieved through cross-hatching or stippling techniques. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing light and dark contrasts typical of etchings.

artworks.title: The Fourth Oriental Head
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn after Jan Lievens
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.9 x 13.2 cm (6 1/4 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a young man depicted from the waist up, positioned in profile, facing to the right. His head is slightly tilted downward. He has a prominent nose and full lips, with a contemplative expression. His hair is long, wavy, and shoulder-length, cascading beneath a large, voluminous beret that covers the top of his head. He wears a dark cloak over a lighter colored garment, and the texture of both is detailed. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain with no distinct features, emphasizing the figure as the central focus.

artworks.title: The Large Lion Hunt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunting scene with hunters on horseback and a lion. The image shows a moment of confrontation between the riders and the lion. The artwork features dynamic composition, energetic line work, and detailed textures. The background includes rough vegetation to add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait in a Heavy Fur Cap
artworks.description: The image is a bust-length view of a person facing slightly to the left. They have curly hair and wear a large hat with a fur collar. The person has a serious expression and is looking directly at the viewer. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Sick Woman with a Large White Headdress (Saskia)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person, showing the upper body and head. The person is facing slightly to the right, with their head turned towards the viewer. The facial features are detailed, with prominent eyes and an expressive face. The person has short hair covered by a hood or shawl. The clothing is loose and drawn with light lines. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain with cross-hatched lines for shading.

artworks.title: The Skater
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man in motion. The sketch shows a figure poised mid-stride, appearing to wield a stick or cane, with one arm crossed almost defensively over his chest. The figure is dressed in loose-fitting clothes, and his expression is intense. His hat is a beret. The background is sketched lightly, providing a sense of depth. The use of light and shadow in the line work suggests the movement and energy of the scene.

artworks.title: The Sleeping Herdsman
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of a pastoral setting. A figure is seated against a tree on the right side, with their head resting on their hand. To the left, two children are seated on the ground in an embrace. The etching shows cross-hatched lines creating texture, implying shadows and forms around the tree and figures. A cow grazes in the distance, partly hidden by foliage. The horizon is obscured by the tree's branches and leaves. The artwork is monochromatic, using the density of lines for contrast and visual impact.

artworks.title: Title Page for R. Knolles Generall Historie of the Turkes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate book title page. The title page features intricate illustrations and decorative elements framing the text. A coat of arms at the top includes a lion, a unicorn, and a crown inside a band with Latin inscriptions. The text announces "The Generall Historie of the Turkes" by Richard Knolles, printed by Adam Islip in 1638. Pillars on each side of the text depict figures in classical attire. Beneath the central text are sculpted faces and a detailed landscape scene. The ornate borders and symmetry of the design emphasize a regal and authoritative intent.

artworks.title: Sir Philip Sidney
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting the upper half of a man's body within an ornate oval frame. The man faces forward with a slight turn to the left. He has an angular face, sharp nose, prominent cheekbones, and a well-groomed mustache. His hair is wavy, reaching just above his shoulders, and he wears a laurel wreath on his head. The man wears classical attire resembling a toga draped over his shoulders. The background within the frame is plain, with intricately decorated edges featuring sculpted motifs such as foliage and drapery. The frame has inscriptions on either side indicating the man's name as "SYDNEY PHILIPPUS." Below the oval is a section of text in an ornate font.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of England
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person from the waist up. The person is seated and turning slightly to their right. In the portrait, their right hand holds a scepter and their left hand holds an orb. The facial features include a smooth complexion, a straight nose, and thin lips. The person's hair is curly and adorned with a crown featuring pearls and an intricate design. The clothing is regal and detailed, with a high lace ruff around the neck, embellished fabric, and intricate embroidery. A bracelet is visible on the person's left wrist. The background is plain, with a coat of arms and decorative text above and below the portrait.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of England
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a person in a forward-facing stance with their head slightly turned to the left. The individual has a composed expression with fine facial features and curly hair styled with an ornate crown embellished with pearls and jewels. They are dressed in an elaborate gown with intricate embroidery, a high lace ruffled collar, and voluminous sleeves with detailed patterns. The person holds a scepter in one hand and an orb in the other, and wears a bracelet on one wrist. The background is plain with decorative text and insignia around the portrait.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of England
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a person seated. The individual is facing slightly to the left with their head slightly turned towards the viewer. They have a distinct facial structure with delicate features, including defined cheekbones, a straight nose, and a small mouth. Their hair is curly, styled into an elegant updo with several decorative hairpins. The attire is elaborate, showcasing a high lace ruff collar surrounding the neck, and a richly detailed garment that includes intricate patterns and textures. A pearl-like necklace adorns the visible portion of the collar. The background consists of a simple circular design with Latin inscriptions around the oval portrait.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of England
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up, centered within an ornate circular frame. She is depicted in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to her left. Her facial features are detailed with a pronounced nose, arched eyebrows, and a composed expression. Her hair is styled in tight curls with decorative elements. The woman is wearing an elaborate, high-collared Elizabethan-era garment with a richly embroidered bodice and voluminous sleeves. She is adorned with a necklace and earrings. The background features a plain textured surface with inscriptions encircling the portrait, and additional textual elements below the image.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing a man's upper body. He is facing forward, with distinguished facial features including a pointed beard and mustache. He wears an embroidered garment with ornamental shoulder armor. The portrait is set in an ornate oval frame with inscriptions and Latin text at the base. The background features decorative scrollwork.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man shown from the chest up. The man is positioned facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer with a faint smile. He has distinctive facial features with a well-groomed goatee and short, wavy hair. He is dressed in elaborate clothing typical of the 17th century, featuring a high ruffled collar and a dark garment adorned with intricate details. There are no visible items of jewelry or objects being held by the person. The background consists of an oval frame with detailed decorations and a wide border with Latin inscriptions, decorative motifs, scrolls, and vases with floral designs. The bottom of the image contains a block of text in a stylized form.

artworks.title: Albert of Austria, Governor of the Southern Netherlands
artworks.description: The illustration shows a man with short hair and a beard in ornate clothing from the Renaissance or Baroque period. He wears a large ruff around his neck and is surrounded by an oval frame with inscriptions. Ornate architectural elements are above the frame, and there are additional texts at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: James I, King of England
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. He is seated or angled slightly to the side. The man's facial features include a mustache and a pointed beard. His hair is styled in a short wavy manner with a laurel wreath. He is dressed in elaborate attire with a lace ruff around his neck, a detailed garment, a fur-trimmed robe or cloak, and a chain necklace. In his right hand, he holds a scepter. The background is dark with circular patterns and Latin inscriptions, and on the right side, there's an emblem attached by a ribbon. The border also contains inscriptions framing the portrait.
